tagline: Hand us the jobs nobody has time for. We will get them done.
intro: Loudhouse is a client-services agency in Glasgow. We take on marketing, operations and delivery work for growing companies, move quickly, and tell you plainly what got done each week.
audience: Growing companies across Scotland and the North of England, from ten to three hundred people, in hospitality, retail, events, software and professional services.
pricing_note: Fixed prices for projects, agreed before we start. A monthly retainer for ongoing work, with the scope written down and a month's notice either way.

services.title: Campaigns
services.description: Launches, seasonal pushes and always-on marketing, planned, written, made and run across the channels your customers actually use.

services.title: Operations
services.description: The processes, tools and checklists behind the work, sorted so your team spends less time chasing and more time doing.

services.title: Delivery
services.description: Projects with a start, an end and a lot of moving parts, run by one lead with a plan, a budget and a weekly update.

services.title: Cover
services.description: A standing team on a monthly retainer for the work that never stops, from reporting to content to supplier wrangling.

process.title: Brief
process.description: Half an hour on a call, then a one-page plan back within two working days: the scope, the price, the dates and who is on it.

process.title: Build
process.description: We get on with it, with a short written update every Friday and a call whenever a decision is yours to make.

process.title: Ship
process.description: The work goes live, we walk you through what we did and what we would do next, and you decide if we carry on.

proof.text: We sent a messy brief on a Monday and had a plan we could sign by Wednesday.
They took the event off our plate completely and the Friday notes meant I never had to ask.
proof.source: Head of marketing, a software company (sample)

proof.text: Quick, clear and never once over the quote.
